declaration.description: Platform-neutral semantic contract reverse-engineered from the tested LoraModule implementation.

agility.composition: owned by container configuration or runtime controller

container_access.construction: A concrete LoraModule reference may be a local variable only while CreateChain() assembles the topology.
container_access.after_construction: All access enters through VirtualModule.ChainHead, Publish, registered handlers, subscriptions or event handlers.
container_access.forbidden: No private/public static field, property or collection may retain a concrete LoraModule instance.
container_access.tail: When LORA is the final module, set ForwardTarget = null explicitly.

factory.signature: public static LoraModule Create(string suffix, int msgId = 0)

ECHO.behavior: Emit /ECHO/DONE and return BuildData with the same context.

INFO.behavior: Emit and return name, AtGroup, enabled, rxCount, address, radio state and setup snapshot.

LOOPBACK.behavior: Publish ECHO to this AtGroup with the same context and report OK or FAIL.

behavior: Parse five integers, ushort LoRa address and five SPI binding values
Validate enum and boolean SPI values before acquiring hardware
Create SpiConnectionSettings exclusively from the validated OPEN values, then create SX1262
Create AutoDrain RX and Manual TX queues

rst.sentinel: -1 disables programmatic chip reset; existing driver semantics.

behavior: Dispose TX queue, RX queue and driver

RESET.behavior: Reset driver, clear setup state, emit /RESET/DONE.

behavior: Create TextPacket carrying the request context
Fire only when radio is TX-ready

SEND_ACK.purpose: Ensure an ACK candidate delivery subscription if missing, then enqueue the unchanged outgoing text packet. No automatic WDG creation or ACK validity decision.
SEND_ACK.validation: Require open/configured driver; validate destination using SEND address rules, exact consumer endpoint, fixed argument count, payload as one text argument and nonempty ackFilter before subscription changes. Payload may be empty; this positional text version has no embedded comma/control chars. Filter grammar is validated by SUB only if creation is needed; an unused supplied filter never replaces an existing one.

subscription.create_filter: command args[3], application data, no hardcoded ACK/tag defaults
subscription.existence: Use supported SUBLIST API to inspect exact consumer and exact topic across all delivery modes, including disabled entries. Any existing route is preserved without SUB, filter update, re-enable or mode change, regardless of origin. Existing PULL/PUSH_PULL/OFF policy may deliberately prevent automatic PUSH handling.
subscription.missing: Only if no exact route exists, create through supported SUB API before enqueue. Respect inherited topic hierarchy; a covering route rejected by SUB is a subscription error, never overwrite/remove it.
subscription.multiple_consumers: Independent consumer endpoints may each have their own ACK subscription.
subscription.concurrency: Serialize ensure/create against concurrent SEND_ACK and subscription command mutations through the LORA command boundary; never overwrite a route that appeared concurrently. Do not access _crossSubs, private key encoding or SubscriptionEntry identity. Use supported derived command extension points and public APIs only.
subscription.lifetime: Created route persists for subsequent traffic and is controlled by existing SUB/UNSUB/TOGGLE commands. No per-packet cleanup; never remove a pre-existing route. Do not automatically undo SWITCH/OFF.

SEND_ACK.send: After successful ensure/preserve, use existing SEND registered handler semantics with destination and payload only; preserve incoming ctx and enqueue exactly once. Do not include consumer/filter in radio payload.
SEND_ACK.result: +OK:<ctx>,<atGroup>:PacketEnqueued; enqueue acceptance only, not proof of ACK delivery or remote receipt.
SEND_ACK.failure: Subscription lookup/creation failure returns ESUB with original diagnostic and no packet enqueue. If SEND fails after route creation, retain route and return existing SEND error. Invalid arguments never mutate routes or enqueue.
SEND_ACK.future: Reserved intent for future packet-Type ACK-request support. This version leaves Type=0x00, header, driver and text protocol unchanged.

semantic_invariants.generation_policy: Preserve the tested behavior below. Do not shorten, redesign or refactor queue, IRQ, half-duplex, cleanup, trace or handler semantics.
semantic_invariants.default_event_handler: Override DefaultEventHandler and TraceLog handler_event with topic, FilterForLog(filter) and args.Join().
semantic_invariants.echo: Use args.Join(); emit /ECHO/DONE; return BuildData with the same context.
semantic_invariants.info: Use inherited RxCount and return exact fields name,atGroup,enabled,rxCount,address,radio,config=[driverInfo]. Format address exactly as 0x followed by four uppercase hexadecimal digits. When the radio is closed, driverInfo is exactly not-opened-radio and config is exactly [not-opened-radio].
semantic_invariants.loopback: Call Publish(AtGroup, ECHO, context, LOOPBACK_TEST); scan all responses for LOOPBACK_TEST; return OK or FAIL.
semantic_invariants.open: Parse and validate every target-specific SPI value supplied by OPEN. Construct SpiConnectionSettings using clockFrequency, mode, dataFlow, chipSelectActiveState and configuration from the request; do not embed their selected target values in generated module source. Map mode by exact tokens Mode0, Mode1, Mode2 or Mode3; map dataFlow by exact tokens MsbFirst or LsbFirst; parse chipSelectActiveState as true or false case-insensitively; map configuration by the SpiBusConfiguration names supported by the selected platform. Create the SX1262 driver and return EOPEN if the resulting driver is null; create AutoDrain RX and Manual TX queues; attach exactly three named handlers. Validate busId, cs and busy >=0; rst and irq >=-1; clockFrequency >0. Forward -1 unchanged to the existing driver; do not change driver implementation.
close_order: detach RX and TX queue handlers
driver.Reset to unregister DIO1 IRQ and clear setup

irq_pin_lifetime.generation_rule: Do not close or dispose pinIrq in generated LoraModule code.
irq_pin_lifetime.ownership: The golden SX1262 driver owns the DIO1 IRQ callback lifecycle while LoraModule retains the shared GPIO controller.
irq_pin_lifetime.close_behavior: CLOSE intentionally leaves pinIrq open after driver Reset and Dispose. Closing or disposing pinIrq in generated LoraModule code can cause UnregisterCallbackForPinValueChangedEvent to throw.
irq_pin_lifetime.reopen_behavior: A subsequent OPEN uses the golden SX1262 constructor, which closes an already-open IRQ pin before reopening it and registering the callback.
irq_pin_lifetime.audit_classification: An open pinIrq after CLOSE is intentional_by_contract and must not be reported as a generated-source resource leak.

semantic_invariants.close_partial_state: Guard rxQueue and txQueue before handler detach and disposal, and guard driver disposal, so CLOSE can safely clean a partially completed OPEN state while preserving the declared cleanup order.
semantic_invariants.setup: Parse syncWord with TryParseLoraAddress; use and expose driver.LastSetupLoRa; SETUP remains repeatable.
semantic_invariants.send: Resolve data exactly once with args.TextArg(1); enqueue TextPacket with request context; call txQueue.FireOneIf(lora.IsReadyForTX()).
semantic_invariants.receive_irq: Lora_OnPacketReceived must enqueue RX and then call txQueue.FireOneIf(txQueue.Count > 0 && lora.IsReadyForTX()).
semantic_invariants.receive_queue: Wrap processing in try/catch; cast item with as RcvPacketArgs; when non-null parse TextPacket.Create2; for text trace count plus From/To as X4 and Len=textPkt.Data.Length, otherwise trace the original received packet header bytes without reserializing TextPacket; emit from,to,RSSI,SNR,data using received TextPacket.Id.
semantic_invariants.transmit_queue: Support both string and TextPacket queue items. A string item becomes a broadcast TextPacket with Id=NextMsgId(); a TextPacket retains its Id. Trace exactly 'count=<count>, Raw: <BitConverter.ToString(buffer)>'; transmit ToLoraArray2; catch and trace transmit processing exceptions at queuetx with context zero; in finally call FireOneIf(count > 0 && lora.IsReadyForTX()), otherwise EnableRxContinuous().

source_generation.determinism: The generated LoraModule.cs must implement this contract literally. Equivalent-looking refactors that alter fields, topic constants, trace text, exception boundaries, context allocation, queue decisions or cleanup order are forbidden.

construction.driver_null_guard: After assigning new SX1262, return EOPEN:Can't open driver if the resulting lora reference is null before queues or handlers are created.

source_generation.open_exception: TraceLog checkpoint=open with command context and exception message; release every driver, queue or handler acquired by this failed OPEN, restore canonical CLOSED state, and return EOPEN:<message>. Do not emit CLOSE events or invoke the public CLOSE handler from the OPEN catch block.
source_generation.close_exception: TraceLog checkpoint=close with command context and exception message; return ECLOSE:<message>.
source_generation.close_cleanup: Use null guards for RX/TX handler detach, RX/TX disposal and driver disposal. Set disposed queue and driver fields to null while retaining ioctrl.
source_generation.setup_exception: TraceLog checkpoint=setup with command context and exception message; return ESETUP:<message>.
source_generation.reset_exception: TraceLog checkpoint=reset with command context and exception message; return ERESET:<message>.
source_generation.send_exception: TraceLog checkpoint=send with command context and exception message; return ESEND:<message>.

receive_irq.exception_boundary: No new catch/rewrite semantics are introduced; enqueue RX then conditionally fire TX exactly as declared by semantic_invariants.receive_irq.

receive_queue.text_trace: QueueRX ctx=TextPacket.Id extra=count=<count> From=<X4> To=<X4> Len=<Data.Length>
receive_queue.non_text_source: Use the original RcvPacketArgs.Packet bytes. Calling ToArray2, ToLoraArray2 or any other reserialization for this trace is forbidden because it can alter a non-text Type byte.
receive_queue.event: EmitEvent(Topics.RX, textPkt.Id, from X4, to X4, RSSI, SNR, textPkt.Data)

transmit_queue.string_item: new TextPacket { From=loraAddress, To=loraBroadcastAddress, Id=NextMsgId(), Data=(string)item }
transmit_queue.wrong_item_trace: queuetx ctx=00000000 extra=count=<count>, wrong item in the queue
transmit_queue.exception_boundary: Catch Exception from item conversion, serialization, trace or transmission; emit error_trace; always execute the declared finally scheduling.
transmit_queue.finally: Use the callback parameter count. If FireOneIf(count > 0 && lora.IsReadyForTX()) is false, call lora.EnableRxContinuous(). Reading txQueue.Count in this finally block is forbidden because concurrent enqueue may change it after the callback item was dequeued.

source_generation.namespace_rule: Emit the declared required_namespaces only; do not add a namespace merely to substitute a different helper or trace representation.
source_generation.send_ack_boundary: SEND_ACK is a registered command using inherited subscription APIs and existing SEND handler; no PING-specific private capability or golden mutation. Keep SEND itself byte/behavior compatible where feasible.

artifact_identity.identity_rule: Logical id plus canonical contract fingerprint identify the reusable module capsule independently of package label, runtime instances and physical locator.

fingerprint.canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON with object keys sorted recursively, insignificant whitespace removed and array order preserved.
fingerprint.rule: Hash the canonical module DDR after replacing this value with an empty string and removing its declaration.version, append one LF byte, then append the canonical AT DDR after removing its declaration.version. Package relabeling alone must not change the semantic contract fingerprint.
fingerprint.incremental_role: Primary semantic-change key. An unchanged value permits reuse of the previously generated module source when platform projection inputs are also compatible.

locator.rule: A repository locator may replace the package-local locator without changing logical identity or contract fingerprint.

runtime_connectivity.purpose: Carry runtime business messaging and Pub/Sub eventing independently of metadata binding.

messaging.context: preserve the 32-bit context across request, response and emitted events

chain.membership: zero or one position per runtime instance

physical.purpose: Expose platform-neutral radio requirements; the selected device HAL supplies SPI, GPIO, address and RF setup metadata at runtime.
validation: Resolve all OPEN and SETUP fields from the selected HAL binding.
Never compile selected bus, pins, address or RF setup values into LoraModule source.
Fail generation when the required radio binding is absent or incomplete.

metadata_connector.purpose: Standard plug-in boundary that keeps the module agile and neutral while supplying configuration, initialization, state policy, logical bindings, physical bindings and instance metadata from the container.
metadata_connector.late_binding: Resolve metadata outside generated module source and apply it during composition or declared runtime lifecycle operations.

logical.projection: container composition; never compiler-hardcode one topology in the reusable module class

physical.absence_semantics: An empty resource map is a valid connector with no HAL requirement.

lifecycle.discover: Resolve capsule by logical id and contract fingerprint.
lifecycle.attach: Create the requested instance and apply instance, logical and enabled physical bindings.
lifecycle.activate: Initialize and start the instance; execute declared runtime OPEN/SETUP bindings only for enabled resources.
lifecycle.detach: Close owned resources according to their contracts, unlink the instance and preserve unrelated module state.
lifecycle.replace: Detach the previous capsule state and attach a compatible resolved capsule without retaining direct static instance access.

incremental_generation.purpose: Expose stable comparison keys so Code-First can update only affected projections while still producing one complete Package 2.

inputs.instance_bindings: selected Runtime.composition.instances entries whose module_ref resolves this capsule
inputs.deployment_binding: selected Deployment.metadata_bindings entry and referenced HAL subset

change_classification.reuse: Identity, contract fingerprint, relevant bindings, platform projection and dependencies are unchanged.
change_classification.regenerate: Contract fingerprint or generated-source platform projection changed.
change_classification.rebind: Contract is unchanged but instance, logical, HAL or activation binding changed; reuse module source and update only affected container/platform artifacts.
change_classification.add: Logical capsule or selected instance exists only in current Model-First.
change_classification.remove: Logical capsule or selected instance exists only in previous Model-First.

output_scope.dependencies: selected platform dependency artifact such as device/packages.config

incremental_generation.reuse_rule: A reused output must be copied byte-identically from the previous verified Package 2 and its prior hash recorded in current provenance.
incremental_generation.safety_rule: Never reuse an output when its complete declared comparison inputs cannot be resolved and verified.

validation: Every runtime instance resolves exactly one logical capsule identity and canonical contract fingerprint.
Physical target values remain outside reusable generated module source.
An empty physical resource map is valid and must not cause generation failure.
Incremental comparison includes only declared relevant binding subsets; unrelated module changes must not invalidate this capsule projection.
Attach or detach must not create direct static access to a concrete module instance.

endpoint_classification.rule: Kinds are explicit; a physical dependency is not automatically a resource endpoint.

HAL.binding_policy: Driver, HAL and third-party metadata are deployment examples. They do not become LORA business identity or a required chain composition.

transmit_flow: SEND builds TextPacket with request context
Return to continuous RX when no queued TX can fire
Runtime.half_duplex_priority: RX AutoDrain has priority; TX Manual fires only when the driver is ready.

generation.semantic_oracle: Design.handlers + Design.semantic_invariants + Design.source_generation in this artifact; no external or unavailable source is required
